bio.text: Chaz Molder, the mayor of Columbia, Tennessee, won the Democratic nomination for Tennessee's 5th Congressional District in the August 2026 primary.

In a Nashville Banner candidate questionnaire he lists serving as mayor of Columbia since 2018 and working as an attorney, with a bachelor's degree from the University of Tennessee and a law degree from the University of Memphis.
In that questionnaire he says he was born and raised in Columbia.
According to his campaign website, he was first elected mayor in 2018 and re-elected in 2022.

sources.title: Chaz Molder wins Democratic nomination for District 5 congressional race
